cd /workspace && timeout 170 python3 -u - << 'PYEOF'
import json, subprocess, sys
CAND='/workspace/submission/main.py'
valid = json.dumps(dict(mode='replay',capacities={'r':0},flows=[],events=[]))
planok = json.dumps(dict(mode='plan',capacities={'r':1},flows=[],warmup=0,pinned=[],offers={}))
lines = [
    valid,
    '',                                   # blank -> error
    '{',                                  # bad json
    '   ',                                 # whitespace only
    valid,
    'x'*50,                                # bad json
    planok,
    '{"mode":"replay","capacities":{"r":1},"flows":[],"events":[]}\r',  # CRLF
    json.dumps({"mode":"plan","capacities":{"r":1},"flows":[],"warmup":0,"pinned":[],"offers":{}}),
    ' ' + valid + ' ',                     # surrounding spaces
    '{"a":1}\n',                           # unknown shape
]
data = ('\n'.join(l for l in lines)).encode() + b'\n'
# huge line test (> 16 MiB)
huge = b'{"mode":"replay","capacities":{"r":1},"flows":[],"events":[],"pad":"' + b'a'*(17*1024*1024) + b'"}'
data2 = valid.encode() + b'\n' + huge + b'\n' + valid.encode() + b'\n'
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',CAND], input=data, capture_output=True, timeout=120)
print('--- mixed lines, rc=%d stderr=%d' % (p.returncode, len(p.stderr)))
for i,l in enumerate(p.stdout.split(b'\n')[:-1]): print(i, l[:110])
print('expected 11 lines, got', len(p.stdout.split(b'\n'))-1)
p2 = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',CAND], input=data2, capture_output=True, timeout=120)
print('--- huge line, rc=%d stderr=%d out=%s' % (p2.returncode, len(p2.stderr), p2.stdout[:200]))
# no trailing newline
p3 = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',CAND], input=valid.encode(), capture_output=True, timeout=60)
print('--- no trailing newline rc=%d out=%r' % (p3.returncode, p3.stdout))
# empty stdin
p4 = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',CAND], input=b'', capture_output=True, timeout=60)
print('--- empty stdin rc=%d out=%r err=%r' % (p4.returncode, p4.stdout, p4.stderr[:200]))
PYEOF
